profile: iPhone 13 screen geometry with uncalibrated desktop CPU stress

environment.browser: VS Code integrated browser, Chromium 150.0.7871.250, Electron 43.7.7
environment.refreshRate: Host scheduling retained, approximately 144 Hz; not iPhone 13 60 Hz

workload.sweep: Two cosine-shaped out-and-back cycles across the overflowing hand
workload.offscreenAnimations: Paused with IntersectionObserver and 128px root margin
workload.comparisonSamples: Hidden and animations paused during each run
workload.assets: Decoded before timing; image generation excluded
workload.trials: Two per renderer, second trial reverses renderer order
workload.trigger: Programmatic button click; no touch-input latency measured

metrics.taskMs: CDP Performance TaskDuration delta in milliseconds around the complete run, including warm-up and test UI; not GPU time.
metrics.styleMs: CDP Performance RecalcStyleDuration delta in milliseconds; subset of taskMs.
metrics.mean: Mean requestAnimationFrame interval in milliseconds during the sweep.
metrics.p95: Nearest-rank 95th percentile requestAnimationFrame interval in milliseconds.
metrics.over60HzBudget: Count of intervals strictly greater than 1000/60 ms; not measured dropped frames on an actual 60 Hz display.

limitations: Screen geometry and density match iPhone 13, but 4x CPU throttling is arbitrary and not calibrated to A15.
Desktop Chromium, GPU, memory bandwidth and refresh scheduling remain; this does not emulate iPhone Safari or establish phone FPS.
No GPU raster/compositing time, energy, memory, touch input, momentum scrolling or real-device performance measured.
Only two runs per renderer; these are observed averages, not statistically established rankings.
This isolated preview excludes the rest of the game and image generation/initial rasterization cost.
Baked SVG foreignObject raster caching requires separate compatibility and fidelity validation in physical iPhone Safari.
DevTools tracing was unavailable due to a tracing-session conflict; only Performance-domain CPU metrics and rAF intervals are reported.
